en: a WIDE 16:9 landscape background for a children's reading app: a bright magical cartoon forest clearing with tall friendly leafy trees framing the left and right edges, soft golden sunlight rays from the top, ferns, small red mushrooms, flowers and green leaves along the bottom edge, a few butterflies near the trees; gentle pastel greens and warm yellow light; the CENTRE of the picture is open and calm (soft light-green meadow and pale sky, very little detail) so white text cards can sit on top; no characters, no animals in the centre
